title: Compute magnon density of states
action: For each material (MnF2, FeF2, CoF2, NiF2), evaluate the magnon dispersion relations on a dense mesh of wave vectors inside the Brillouin zone using the analytical formulas and the exchange parameters provided in the instruction, and construct the magnon density of states g(ν).

title: Calculate spin‑wave specific heat
action: Using the density of states g(ν) from the previous step, evaluate the integral for the spin‑wave contribution C_M(T) for each material at every required temperature. Write the results to a CSV file.
description: Computed spin‑wave specific heat C_M(T) values for MnF2, FeF2, CoF2, and NiF2 at the temperatures listed in the paper's Table 3 (calculated column).
output_schema: Columns: Material (string), Temperature_K (float), C_M_J_per_K_per_mole (float). Rows for: NiF2 at 0.36 K; all materials at 2.5, 5.0, 7.5, 10.0, 12.5, 15.0, 20.0, 25.0, 30.0, 35.0 K; additionally MnF2, FeF2, NiF2 at 40.0, 45.0, 50.0 K. Values as floats, scientific notation where appropriate.
